summary: Vouchers can only be paid, in a single payment, by an enrolled recipient to a merchant that is active in the agency merchant registry for the voucher category (OVFOOD: food, OVAGRI: farm inputs), between the programme start and expiry. Transfers between recipients are refused. Per recipient, OVFOOD spending is capped at 5.00 per programme-local day and 10.00 per rolling 7 days; OVAGRI at 25.00 per day and 40.00 per 7 days. Approved payments are wrapped by the approval server in an authorise, pay, de-authorise transaction whose memo is the hash of these rules.
